# Siri

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Apple's voice-activated virtual assistant, integrated into iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.

## Scope note

Voice-triggered entry points into the PKM system, typically via Siri-invoked Shortcuts - distinct from the Shortcut automation itself.
